title: When the Vector Falls
author: Casper Dunmore
blurb: Mara Zhou, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
